result.summary:
REQ-ANALYST: REQ-001 reworked. Only the REQ-001 entry changed: old lines 6-36 were replaced by new lines 6-203 of docs/requirements.yaml in one atomic splice (temp file + rename). The two comment lines about WF-06 between REQ-001 and REQ-002 and everything from REQ-002 on are byte-identical.

What REQ-001 now settles:
- What the owner gets: `cd tools && npm run pixel-office` prints «Pixel Office: http://127.0.0.1:<порт>/». The default port is fixed and documented in tools/README.md. The page updates live (5 s at most, no reload) and shows an office with role characters, a task list, an event journal and an agent card, all built from one array of events. The stack follows decisions/0003: tools/, Node 22, no runtime dependencies, depends_on [REQ-002], and it does not need 0001.
- A task is one subagent run (Agent tool): role (agent_type), short description, start, end and a state («в работе», «завершена» or «окончание не записано»). The main session is a separate row with no prompt text. Rules cover a resumed subagent (same task), a stop event with no start (no task: internal Claude Code agents), and lost ends after a server restart, a session end or an interrupted turn («окончание не записано», never a false «в работе»).
- Hook facts come from the official docs, opened 2026-09-30 (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings), with sections named. The main ones: hook input has no time field, so hook time means the clock read when the hook fires. SubagentStart also fires on resume. SubagentStop also fires for internal agents. An exit code other than 0 or 2 shows a hook-error notice. stdout of UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart goes into Claude’s context. The project .claude/settings.json is read from the session’s primary working directory. Four things are left to the design as explicit questions: which events to use, how the task description links to agent_id, command or http hook and async, and how the hook finds Node 22.
- Stored: time, source, hook_event_name, session_id, agent_id, agent_type, tool_use_id and a description of at most 100 characters. Not stored or shown: prompt text, the subagent’s task text, answers and background_tasks, transcript, cwd and scratchpad paths, and any other input field. Reasons: they are not needed to see tasks; they risk leaking secrets and personal data (Q7) from a journal that is unencrypted and readable without login; Claude Code already keeps the transcripts; and [образец]’s rule shows no model reasoning.
- Journal ~/.sai-pixel-office/events.jsonl (append-only) and secret ~/.sai-pixel-office/write-secret (file 0600, folder 0700) sit outside the repo. The reason: npm run snapshot covers the whole sai/ tree, and other runs’ snapshot-diff checks (REQ-004 AC4, REQ-006 AC14) would break.
- Server: listens on 127.0.0.1 only, returns 403 for any other Host, sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, sets a CSP. It has one write route, protected by the secret. A time check of ±60 s blocks back-dated events. The hook exits 0 within 2 s with empty stdout in 6 failure cases. Each handler timeout is at most 5 s. Hooks are set only in sai/.claude/settings.json.
- AC1 is checked by two named steps. Step «реальная сессия» (UAT-RUNNER): run `claude -p` in sai/, attach the journal lines, grep for the session_id inside sai/ (it may appear only in the handoff folder), then run again with the server stopped. Step «обычная сессия владельца»: journal lines from the owner’s own session in sai/ plus the owner’s exact words on hook-error notices. This puts UAT-RUNNER into the route between TEST-RUNNER and RELEASE-VALIDATOR, which is ORCH’s call.
- Out of scope, listed with reasons. From [образец]: login and permissions, the requirement card and the runtime API, question/answer/meeting events, replay and speeds, the requirement filter, a fixed Asia/Almaty zone, simulation mode, the 12 fixed roles, .NET and EF Core, the seed file, and decoration. Not from [образец]: Claude Code’s own task list, permission waits, tool-level actions, sessions outside sai/, journal rotation, and the paid product.
- There are now 16 criteria (up from 8), and each has «Проверка:». The jq and grep commands were taken from the parsed YAML and run on samples: each gave the expected result.

Open questions:
(1) Owner and ORCH: the hooks in sai/.claude/settings.json run only in sessions started in sai/, or moved there with /cd (settings docs). This pipeline session seems to have been started from platform/: the scratchpad path contains -Users-whooch-solution-platform, and platform/CLAUDE.md is in context. This needs checking. Unless the pipeline runs from sai/, Pixel Office will show none of its work. Where to start sessions is the owner’s decision; decisions/0003 forbids user-level hooks.
(2) Owner: here a task means a subagent launch. If he also meant Claude Code’s own task list (TaskCreated/TaskCompleted), that is a separate requirement.
(3) Design: which events to use. How the description links to agent_id: the docs do not call tool_response.agentId in PostToolUse and agent_id in SubagentStart the same identifier. Command or http hook, and async: an http connection failure is a non-blocking error, and async hooks are killed at -p teardown. Node 22 in the hook environment: on this machine <каталог Homebrew> is Node 25.2.1, Node 22 is only at <каталог Homebrew> via the shell profile, and Claude Code runs as the VS Code extension 2.1.284.
(4) UAT: `claude` is not on PATH in agent shells (command -v claude prints nothing), so the design must name the binary or command to use.
(5) ORCH: REQ-006 AC14 protects tools/src/snapshot.js and .claude/agents/. REQ-001 paths must be declared one by one in parallel-runs.jsonl, because tools/ as a whole cannot be declared; .claude/settings.json must be declared too. If the REQ-006 before-snapshot is taken while PO-20260930-01 is still open, docs/requirements.yaml must also be declared for this run.
(6) Size: REQ-001 is one feature but large. If REQ-VALIDATOR finds it too big, the proposed split is (a) hook, server, journal and task list; (b) office canvas, movement and agent card. That needs new REQ ids, which is outside this handoff’s edit scope.
(7) STATE.md, «Что делать дальше» items 2-3, still puts REQ-001 after 0001. This is for ORCH or DOC-UPDATER.
